## 🔴 HIGH IMPACT

### ARM — Arm Holdings · **BEARISH**
*Reason: CFO insider sale + stretched valuation triggers aggressive profit-taking*

ARM plunged **–8.7%** today, the largest single-day drop among watchlist names. Three factors converged: CFO Jason Child disclosed a sale of 10,400 shares at $300/share (~$3.12M) on Sep 21 via a pre-arranged plan; analyst consensus fair value sits around $287, near the current price, offering no margin for error; and momentum traders locked in gains following the sharp Sep 21 rally tied to Meta's Muse AI announcements. The stock has retreated significantly from its 52-week high of $452.70. No offsetting catalyst in sight near-term.

**Sources:** [Investing.com – Why is ARM sliding today](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/why-is-arm-stock-sliding-today-93CH-4920615) · [GuruFocus – ARM Shares Drop 9%](https://www.gurufocus.com/news/9100568/arm-holdings-arm-shares-drop-9-after-strong-september-rally)

### AVGO — Broadcom · **BEARISH**
*Reason: Maintained AI guidance instead of raising it; sector-wide selloff followed*

Broadcom's most recent quarterly results (Q3 FY2026, reported Sep 2) delivered a disappointing AI chip outlook — management chose to maintain rather than increase its 2026 guidance, triggering a drop of up to **–15%** in AVGO and rippling across the semiconductor sector. Today's session showed continued pressure, with money rotating out of chips into Healthcare and Financials. AVGO is now down **30%+ since June**. Intel (INTC), AMD, and Micron (MU) all trimmed losses during the session but remain under pressure.

**Sources:** [Yahoo Finance – Intel, AMD, Micron trim losses after Broadcom selloff](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/article/intel-amd-micron-shares-trim-losses-after-broadcom-results-spark-semiconductor-sector-sell-off-130128361.html) · [TradingKey – Broadcom stock drop analysis](https://www.tradingkey.com/analysis/stocks/us-stocks/262185907-broadcom-avgo-stock-drop-ai-revenue-100-billion-target-tradingkey)

### TSLA — Tesla · **BEARISH**
*Reason: Q3 delivery miss expected; JPMorgan cuts price target*

Tesla fell approximately **–4%** (closing ~$359). Two catalysts: (1) Cantor Fitzgerald projects Q3 deliveries of **421,758 vehicles**, well below the Wall Street consensus of **448,679**, with energy storage deployments also seen shortfalling (15 GWh vs 17.1 GWh estimate); (2) JPMorgan analyst Rajat Gupta cut his price target from $445 → **$415** (Neutral). The formal delivery report is expected later this week, keeping near-term sentiment cautious. Cantor maintains Overweight/$485 PT.

### SNOW — Snowflake · **BEARISH**
*Reason: Proposed $3.5B convertible offering introduces dilution risk*

Snowflake fell **–4%** to $321.65 after announcing a $3.5B convertible senior notes offering (two tranches, no regular interest). The company is using proceeds for capped calls, retiring existing converts, and general corporate purposes. Despite capped call structures limiting dilution, the market reacted negatively. SNOW is still **+47.6% YTD** and carries $4.3B in cash against a last-quarter net loss of $191.7M on 35% revenue growth. Oracle (ORCL) and Datadog fell in sympathy.

**Sources:** [24/7 Wall St. – Snowflake $3.5B convert](https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/09/28/snowflake-slides-4-on-proposed-3-5b-convertible-offering-oracle-falls-3-datadog-drops-4/)
